Primary_Objective: First U.S. crewed suborbital spaceflight flown by Alan Shepard.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Redstone rocket launch; suborbital trajectory reaching 116 miles altitude; manual hand-attitude control testing in microgravity; splashdown recovery.

Primary_Objective: Second U.S. suborbital mission flown by Virgil 'Gus' Grissom.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Suborbital flight path; manual attitude control maneuvers; evaluation of spacecraft cabin environmental control; explosive hatch deployment post-landing.

Primary_Objective: First U.S. crewed orbital flight flown by John Glenn.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Atlas launch vehicle insertion; 3 full Earth orbits; manual fly-by-wire attitude override following autopilot malfunction; retro-rocket burn and reentry thermal shield protection.

Primary_Objective: 5-hour orbital science mission flown by Scott Carpenter.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Horizon tracking and celestial observation experiments; fuel management for attitude control thrusters; retrofire execution.

Primary_Objective: 6-orbit engineering evaluation flown by Walter Schirra.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Strict reaction control system fuel conservation; suit cooling loop assessment; orbital trajectory navigation.

Primary_Objective: Final Mercury mission, 22 orbits over 34 hours flown by Gordon Cooper.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Extended day-long spaceflight endurance protocols; manual reentry alignment after electrical power failure.

Primary_Objective: Uncrewed orbital and suborbital spacecraft and Titan II launch vehicle tests.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Structural integrity verification, automated launch guidance, heat shield reentry performance.

Primary_Objective: First crewed Gemini flight with Gus Grissom and John Young.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: First orbital plane change maneuvers using Orbit Attitude and Maneuvering System (OAMS); manual spacecraft translation.

Primary_Objective: First American spacewalk (EVA) performed by Ed White with James McDivitt.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: 22-minute EVA tethered protocol using Hand-Held Maneuvering Unit (HHMU); 4-day flight endurance tracking.

Primary_Objective: 8-day long-duration flight evaluating fuel cell technology.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Fuel cell power generation monitoring; radar evaluation pods rendezvous maneuvers; long-term crew physiology tracking.

Primary_Objective: 14-day long-duration endurance mission and rendezvous target.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Extended microgravity habitation; shirt-sleeve environment testing; passive target station keeping.

Primary_Objective: First space rendezvous with Gemini 7 flown by Schirra and Stafford.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Active station-keeping within 1 foot of target; radar navigation and orbital phasing thrust burns.

Primary_Objective: First docking in space with Agena Target Vehicle (Armstrong and Scott).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Precision orbital docking; immediate emergency undocking and Reentry Control System (RCS) thruster abort following stuck thruster spin.

Primary_Objective: Rendezvous and complex EVA maneuvers with Augmented Target Docking Adapter.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Work-load evaluation during EVA; visual rendezvous techniques; Astronaut Maneuvering Unit (AMU) flight testing.

Primary_Objective: Dual rendezvous with two separate Agena vehicles.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Agena secondary propulsion engine burns for orbital altitude boosting; retrieval of micrometeorite collector from passive target.

Primary_Objective: First-orbit direct ascent rendezvous and tethered artificial gravity test.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: High-apogee orbit burn (1,374 km); tethered station-keeping rotation generating artificial gravity.

Primary_Objective: Final Gemini mission mastering underwater-trained EVA procedures (Aldrin and Lovell).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Body-restraint foot restraints and handholds during 5.5 hours of successful EVA; total solar eclipse photography.

Primary_Objective: Pre-flight test crewed by Grissom, White, and Chaffee.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: High-pressure 100% oxygen cabin atmosphere; electrical arcing triggered cabin fire leading to redesign of Apollo hatch and materials.

Primary_Objective: Uncrewed qualification of Saturn V rocket and Lunar Module.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Saturn V S-IC, S-II, S-IVB staging; heat shield reentry qualification at lunar return velocities.

Primary_Objective: First crewed Apollo orbital test flight in Command and Service Module (CSM).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Service Propulsion System (SPS) engine burn firings; live TV broadcasts; rendezvous with Saturn S-IVB stage.

Primary_Objective: First human flight to and orbit around the Moon (Borman, Lovell, Anders).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Trans-Lunar Injection (TLI) burn; 10 lunar orbits; Lunar Orbit Insertion (LOI) and Trans-Earth Injection (TEI) engine maneuvers.

Primary_Objective: First crewed flight testing of complete Apollo spacecraft including Lunar Module.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Active LM extraction, docking, descent/ascent engine firings, and crew transfer via docking tunnel in Earth orbit.

Primary_Objective: Full dress rehearsal for lunar landing in lunar orbit.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: LM separation and descent to within 8.4 nautical miles of lunar surface; ascent stage staging and rendezvous with CSM.

Primary_Objective: First crewed lunar landing (Armstrong, Aldrin, Collins) at Sea of Tranquility.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Semi-manual lunar descent override avoiding boulders; surface EVA (2 hrs 31 min); solar wind & moon rock collection; LM ascent and lunar orbit rendezvous.

Primary_Objective: Precision lunar landing at Ocean of Storms near Surveyor 3.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Pinpoint landing radar navigation; retrieval of Surveyor 3 components; deployment of Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP).

Primary_Objective: Successful crew rescue following SM oxygen tank explosion (Lovell, Swigert, Haise).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: LM 'Aquarius' utilized as lifeboat; manual alignment burns using Sun/Earth terminator sight lines; free-return trajectory around Moon.

Primary_Objective: Lunar landing at Fra Mauro formation (Shepard, Mitchell, Roosa).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Modular Equipment Transporter (MET) handcart deployment; active seismic experiments; surface geology sampling.

Primary_Objective: First J-series extended scientific mission at Hadley-Apennine.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV) operations; subsatellite deployment in lunar orbit; deep-core drilling.

Primary_Objective: Lunar highlands exploration at Descartes crater.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: LRV traverse across rugged terrain; UV camera/spectrograph astronomy; 95 kg regolith sample collection.

Primary_Objective: Final Apollo crewed lunar landing at Taurus-Littrow with scientist-astronaut Harrison Schmitt.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: 22-hour total EVA duration; LRV fender field repair; discovery of orange volcanic glass soil.

Primary_Objective: America's first space station accommodating three long-duration crews.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: EVA thermal parasol deployment and solar array un-jamming repairs; solar astrophysics via Apollo Telescope Mount; 84-day record flight.

Primary_Objective: First international crewed spaceflight docking between US Apollo and Soviet Soyuz.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Universal Docking Module operations; dual-language joint science experiments; crew exchange and orbital handshake.

Primary_Objective: First flight of the Space Shuttle system piloted by Young and Crippen.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Solid Rocket Booster (SRB) separation; thermal protection tile inspection; unpowered unpowered glide approach and lakebed landing at Edwards AFB.

Primary_Objective: Maiden flight of Challenger and first Shuttle Extravehicular Activity (EVA).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Deployment of Tracking and Data Relay Satellite (TDRS-1); Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) suit qualification spacewalk.

Primary_Objective: First spaceflight of an American woman (Sally Ride).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Shuttle Remote Manipulator System (RMS) robot arm operations; deployment and retrieval of SPAS-01 satellite.

Primary_Objective: First in-orbit repair of a satellite (Solar Maximum Mission).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Manned Maneuvering Unit (MMU) jetpack untethered spacewalk capture; payload bay servicing and redeployment.

Primary_Objective: Tragic loss of Challenger crew 73 seconds post-launch due to SRB O-ring seal failure.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Launch destruction investigation leading to complete SRB joint redesign and two-year flight grounding.

Primary_Objective: Post-Challenger return-to-flight safety validation mission.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Launch escape pressure suit qualification; TDRS deployment; advanced flight control system testing.

Primary_Objective: Deployment of the Hubble Space Telescope.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: RMS robot arm high-altitude release (612 km); solar array deployment monitoring; secondary payload operations.

Primary_Objective: First docking of Space Shuttle with Russian Space Station Mir.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Precision orbital proximity operations and soft docking with Kristall module; Mir crew rotation exchange.

Primary_Objective: First International Space Station assembly flight.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Mating of Unity node with Russian Zarya module using RMS arm; 3 assembly EVAs connecting external cables and antennas.

Primary_Objective: Tragic loss of Columbia during reentry due to left-wing foam strike damage.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: 16-day microgravity science mission; foam impact investigation leading to mandatory boom sensor inspections on future flights.

Primary_Objective: Final servicing mission to the Hubble Space Telescope.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: 5 complex EVAs installing Wide Field Camera 3, Cosmic Origins Spectrograph, and replacing gyroscopes/batteries.

Primary_Objective: 135th and final flight of the Space Shuttle Program.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Delivery of Multi-Purpose Logistics Module (MPLM) Raffaello to ISS; final shuttle landing and transition to commercial crew.

Primary_Objective: Continuous human research laboratory orbiting Earth since November 2000.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Microgravity biological/physical experiments; station attitude control; spacewalk maintenance; commercial/international crew rotation.

Primary_Objective: US commercial crew launches transporting astronauts to ISS aboard Dragon.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Autonomous Falcon 9 launch and Dragon docking; manual touch-screen control backup; soft-water splashdown recovery.

Primary_Objective: Uncrewed test flight of Space Launch System (SLS) and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: SLS Block 1 core stage firing; Trans-Lunar Injection; distant retrograde lunar orbit entry (DRO); high-speed skip reentry heat shield test.

Primary_Objective: First crewed Artemis flight carrying 4 astronauts on a lunar free-return trajectory.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Proximity operations demonstration in LEO; lunar flyby trajectory alignment; deep-space life support and communication verification.

Primary_Objective: First crewed lunar south pole landing under Artemis.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Orion docking with Human Landing System (HLS) in lunar orbit; descent to lunar South Pole; surface EVAs collecting polar water ice.

Primary_Objective: Pioneering impactor and soft-lander lunar surface exploration.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: High-speed crash imaging (Ranger); touchdown shock absorber telemetry and surface soil mechanics (Surveyor).

Primary_Objective: High-resolution mapping and resource identification of the Moon.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Polar mapping orbit; narrow-angle camera imaging for 50cm surface resolution; laser altimetry for polar crater shade mapping.

Primary_Objective: First successful Mars flyby (Mariner 4) and first spacecraft to orbit another planet (Mariner 9).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: TV camera digital tape recorder telemetry; orbital insertion burn firing; mapping major dust storms, volcanoes, and canyons.

Primary_Objective: First successful soft landings and life-detection biology experiments on Mars.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Aeroshell heat shield reentry, parachute deployment, terminal retro-rocket firing; automated soil arm scoop sampling.

Primary_Objective: First robotic Mars rover pathfinder testing airbag landing system.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Direct atmospheric entry with deceleration airbags; ramp deployment; autonomous hazard avoidance rove navigation.

Primary_Objective: Geological exploration proving ancient surface liquid water on Mars.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Airbag bouncing touchdown; solar array cleaning by dust devils; rock abrasion tool (RAT) grinding and Moessbauer spectrometer analysis.

Primary_Objective: Exploring Gale Crater to assess past habitability.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Sky Crane powered descent landing system; SAM mass spectrometer sample analysis; nuclear RTG power management.

Primary_Objective: Searching for signs of ancient biosignatures and first powered flight on another planet.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Terrain-Relative Navigation landing; sample caching tube drill sealing; Ingenuity rotorcraft autonomous flight control.

Primary_Objective: Atmospheric probes and synthetic aperture radar mapping of Venus.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: High-temperature atmospheric probe drops; radar altimetry through dense cloud deck; aerobraking orbit shaping.

Primary_Objective: First spacecraft to orbit Mercury.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Complex gravity assists (1 Earth, 2 Venus, 3 Mercury); sunshade thermal management; orbital insertion burn.

Primary_Objective: First flybys of Jupiter and Saturn and first probes to achieve solar escape velocity.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Asteroid belt traversal; intense Jovian radiation belt measurement; spin-stabilized navigation.

Primary_Objective: Grand Tour of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and exploration of interstellar space.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Multi-planet planetary gravity assist maneuvers; Golden Record playback payload; interstellar plasma density measurement.

Primary_Objective: Detailed study of Jupiter and discovery of subsurface ocean on Europa.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Descent probe release into Jovian atmosphere (160 km drop); high-gain antenna failure workaround via tape recorder; intentional impact into Jupiter.

Primary_Objective: 13-year exploration of Saturn, its rings, and landing Huygens on Titan.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Huygens probe atmospheric entry and landing on Titan; icy plume flybys of Enceladus; 'Grand Finale' diving orbits between Saturn and rings.

Primary_Objective: First flyby of Pluto and Kuiper Belt object Arrokoth.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Hibernation flight mode; high-speed Pluto flyby (13,700 km); optical navigation to target Kuiper Belt objects.

Primary_Objective: Probing Jupiter's interior (Juno) and assessing habitability of moon Europa (Europa Clipper).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Highly elliptical polar orbits minimizing radiation exposure; titanium radiation vault shielding; ice-penetrating radar scans.

Primary_Objective: Asteroid 433 Eros landing, comet Wild 2 dust sample return, and comet Tempel 1 impact.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Precision asteroid orbit/landing; aerogel collection grid deployment; hypervelocity copper projectile impact navigation.

Primary_Objective: First spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial destinations (Vesta and Ceres).
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Xenon ion propulsion cruise; low-altitude mapping orbit transfers; surface mineralogy classification.

Primary_Objective: Asteroid Bennu sample collection and return to Earth in 2023.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Touch-And-Go (TAG) nitrogen gas sample collection arm actuation; sample return capsule Earth reentry landing; extended mission to Apophis.

Primary_Objective: First planetary defense kinetic impactor demonstration on asteroid Dimorphos.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Autonomous Real-time Navigation (SMART Nav) impact guidance; hypervelocity collision at 6.6 km/s; orbital period change verification.

Primary_Objective: Continuous monitoring of solar flares, magnetic field, and flying into the Sun's corona.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Carbon-composite heat shield thermal protection at 1,400°C; extreme ultraviolet solar imaging; coronal mass ejection warning systems.

Primary_Objective: Revolutionary optical and UV astronomy observing deep universe.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Fine Guidance Sensor pointing control (0.007 arcsec accuracy); low Earth orbit servicing interfaces; deep field multi-exposure exposures.

Primary_Objective: High-energy X-ray and infrared cosmic imaging.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Grazing incidence X-ray mirrors; liquid helium cryogenic cooling loop monitoring; exoplanet infrared light curve tracking.

Primary_Objective: Discovering thousands of exoplanets using the transit photometry method.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Continuous wide-field star brightness monitoring; reaction wheel momentum dumping; sky sector survey stepping.

Primary_Objective: Premier deep-space infrared observatory stationed at Sun-Earth L2.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Ariane 5 launch to L2; 5-layer sunshield automated deployment; 18-segment beryllium mirror hexagonal alignment to nanometer accuracy.

Primary_Objective: 50+ year continuous satellite imagery record of Earth's surface.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: Sun-synchronous polar orbits; Operational Land Imager (OLI) multispectral band scanning; environmental land cover change tracking.

Primary_Objective: Comprehensive satellite monitoring of Earth's atmosphere, oceans, ice, and land.
Operational_Guide_Summary: Manual Protocol: MODIS/AIRS Earth remote sensing suite; SAR dual-frequency radar interferometry; climate feedback data telemetry.
